name: git-workspace
description: Clones the target repo into /workspace and puts the agent on its own <agent-prefix>/<RUN_ID> branch, committing under the agent's own git identity, resuming an existing one when asked.

settings.label: Branch prefix
settings.description: Leading segment of each run's branch, <prefix>/<date>-<id>. Default: BRANCH_PREFIX in the repo's .env, else the agent's own prefix.

settings.label: Base branch
settings.description: Branch new agent branches are cut from. Default: the repo's default branch (origin/HEAD).
